canonical_name: LDPC-codes -- Radford M. Neal's software for low density parity check codes
lineage: Neal LDPC software (2001-2012, U Toronto): construction of sparse parity-check matrices, encoding via dense/mixed/sparse methods, channel simulation, and belief-propagation (sum-product) decoding; a reference implementation for Gallager/MacKay-Neal codes
version: github.com/radfordneal/LDPC-codes default branch as of 2026-09-12 (recorded commit in hashes)

license.spdx: custom permissive (Neal: free for any purpose with notice; see index.html/COPYRIGHT)

entry_points: make-ldpc, make-gen, encode, transmit, decode, verify, extract (pipeline of CLI tools)

example.input: the shipped test scripts (random codes, BSC/AWGN channels)

upstream_docs: MacKay & Neal, Near Shannon limit performance of low density parity check codes, 1996

human_capability_summary.built_to: correct transmission errors with sparse-graph codes decoded by iterative probabilistic message passing
human_capability_summary.pressure: approach the Shannon limit with practical decoding complexity
human_capability_summary.success_means: block/bit error rate after decoding, at a given channel noise, near the code's threshold

known_human_problem_solved: near-capacity error correction by belief propagation
